instruction.text: The picture shows which animals Eddie saw at the zoo. Select the words and punctuation to build a list in the order shown below.

instruction.text: The picture shows what Molly did on holiday. Select the words and punctuation to build a list in the order shown below.

atoms.a: Molly went to the beach, read a book, took some photos and played volleyball.
